 Chennai techie travelled nearly 2,100km to meet influencer about to get married in Delhi, lost his life

 Print (AI image) A techie named Abhinav died after being allegedly assaulted in east Delhi's Madhu Vihar. NEW DELHI: The investigation into the death of a techie, who was allegedly beaten up by the father and a neighbour of a woman social media influencer in east Delhi ’s Madhu Vihar on Nov 7, has revealed that he had been allegedly infatuated with her and travelled nearly 2,100 km from Chennai to meet her after learning about her impending marriage. As reported by TOI Thursday, two people, including the woman’s father and the neighbour, were arrested in connection with the incident. Police registered two FIRs, one on the influencer’s complaint alleging trespassing by the techie, Abhinav , and the other in connection with the fatal assault on him. The second complaint had initially been registered on charges of voluntarily causing grievous hurt and common intention, but Section 105 of Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), pertaining to culpable homicide not amounting to murder, was subsequently added after his death. The probe has found no evidence of any prior acquaintance between the man and the woman. Abhinav, a native of Uttar Pradesh, used to work with an IT firm in Chennai. The influencer, who has over two million followers, told police that she had been receiving persistent messages from anonymous Instagram accounts, including comments about her daily routine and personal life. She said she initially ignored them as she was accustomed to receiving such messages. According to her complaint, the man had allegedly been trying to contact her for several months. She further told police that she got engaged on June 22 this year and announced it on her social media platforms. Soon after, she allegedly began receiving messages from an Instagram account that had been contacting her for a long time and posting inappropriate comments. She alleged that on July 10-11, an unidentified man entered her house and created a scene, shouting, “I love you, madam. Don’t get married to anyone else.” Her family members and neighbours tried to reason with him. The man allegedly apologised and promised not to repeat the behaviour or contact her again. She did not file a police complaint at the time. The woman claimed that although messages from that particular account stopped subsequently, she continued receiving messages from other anonymous Instagram accounts, which she chose to ignore. According to her complaint to police, her marriage was scheduled for this Dec, an information she shared on social media. On Nov 7, the man allegedly entered her house again and began shouting her name. She recognised him as the same person who had created a disturbance in July, she told police. She alleged that the man was heavily intoxicated and unable to stand properly. When her father questioned him about his presence, he allegedly misbehaved with the family and assaulted her father, saying he would not allow her to marry anyone else. Her neighbours intervened and tried to remove him from the premises. During the altercation, he allegedly fell on the roadside twice or thrice. The influencer claimed he sustained a head injury after falling down and denied that her father or the neighbour was responsible for causing it. Abhinav died on Nov 14. Police arrested the influencer’s father and the neighbour in connection with the case. Further investigation is underway.
